audit_scope.phase_1_question: Did the precommitment operationalize, rather than extend or relax, the exact immutable RoadmapItem.verification_criteria text and any carried decision-letter criterion?
audit_scope.phase_2a_question: Does each recorded verdict follow the exact immutable criterion against the original/revised manuscript evidence, independently of author persuasion?
audit_scope.decision_recomputation_boundary: B1-B6 is recomputed provisionally from the Phase-2A rows and the Phase-2A new_issues arrays, assuming no later Phase-2B adjustment. No Round-1 outcome, checker, abort, traceability, or verification output was read.

auditor_provenance.same_family_limitation: This is a fresh-context, role-separated audit but not a human-, provider-, or model-family-distinct evaluation. Same-family correlated judgment and shared blind spots remain possible; the audit is not an independence certificate.

method.criterion_authority: The exact RoadmapItem.verification_criteria string is the immutable level-1 yardstick. Carried decision-letter text may only operationalize it. Roadmap suggestions, author adjudication, patch scope, and later persuasion do not create acceptance requirements.

classification_rule.FULLY_ADDRESSED: All conjuncts of the exact criterion are satisfied, including an expressly permitted alternative.
classification_rule.PARTIALLY_ADDRESSED: There is genuine criterion-directed progress, but at least one required conjunct remains unsatisfied.
classification_rule.NOT_ADDRESSED: The revision supplies no substantive evidence satisfying the criterion; a clearer admission that evidence is absent is not itself the requested evidence.
classification_rule.MADE_WORSE: The item's subject is degraded relative to the exact original manuscript.
classification_rule.CANNOT_VERIFY: The bound evidence cannot support a positive or negative comparison.

method.equivalent_fix_rule: A nonliteral location or format is accepted only when it preserves every semantic requirement and direct-checkability function of the criterion.
method.scope_artifact_rule: The evidence bundle and author-adjudication sidecar were used only to confirm the bound round and authorized scope, never as criterion or addressedness evidence.
